scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @squidflag/contracts && npm run lint -w @squidflag/flag-engine && npm run lint -w @squidflag/api && npm run lint -w @squidflag/dashboard
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @squidflag/contracts && npm run lint:fix -w @squidflag/flag-engine && npm run lint:fix -w @squidflag/api && npm run lint:fix -w @squidflag/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @squidflag/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @squidflag/flag-engine && npm run typecheck -w @squidflag/api && npm run typecheck -w @squidflag/dashboard
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,api,dashboard "npm run dev:packages" "npm run api" "npm run dashboard"
scripts.check: npm run db:generate -w @squidflag/api && npm run build:packages && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:boundaries && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:int && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:unit && npm run test:int && npm run test:e2e
